name: Protein To Gene Identity Bridge
plain_language_rule: Predict treatment when The drug directly physically engages the protein The pinned descendant closure is biolink:binds, biolink:directly_physically_interacts_with.; The protein is a product of the gene The pinned descendant closure is biolink:gene_product_of.; The gene is genetically associated with disease The pinned descendant closure is biolink:gene_associated_with_condition.
hypothesis: An explicit protein-to-gene identity relation may connect pharmacologic protein targets to gene disease evidence.

nodes.role: Protein physically engaged by the drug
nodes.explanation: Protein physically engaged by the drug.

edges.subject: chemical
edges.explanation: The drug directly physically engages the protein The pinned descendant closure is biolink:binds, biolink:directly_physically_interacts_with.

edges.subject: protein
edges.explanation: The protein is a product of the gene The pinned descendant closure is biolink:gene_product_of.

edges.subject: gene
edges.explanation: The gene is genetically associated with disease The pinned descendant closure is biolink:gene_associated_with_condition.

mechanism.rationale: An explicit protein-to-gene identity relation may connect pharmacologic protein targets to gene disease evidence. The graph pattern is a hypothesis, not proof of clinical efficacy.

execution.cypher_template: MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[target:{{relationship_types:target}}]->(protein:Protein) WHERE target.predicate IN {{predicates:target}} MATCH (protein:Protein)-[identity:{{relationship_types:identity}}]->(gene:GeneOrGeneProduct) WHERE identity.predicate IN {{predicates:identity}} MATCH (gene:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[association:{{relationship_types:association}}]->(disease:Disease) WHERE association.predicate IN {{predicates:association}} RETURN chemical.id AS subject_id,disease.id AS object_id,count(DISTINCT gene) AS support_count

limitations: Unknown predictions are unlabeled, not known negatives.
Canonical graph identifiers are deduplicated; parallel evidence does not multiply gene support.
Source assertions lack dose, exposure, clinical context, and experimental causal validation.
